phase_name: Fallback ladder, lazy trigram migration, and result envelope in literature-search.sh

objectives.description: Fallback ladder in both search_db() definitions, match_tier tagging, envelope output
Verify against real DB: punctuation classes, plain query regression, trigram firing, lazy migration, read-only degradation, unmatchable query

approaches_tried.approach: count(*) FROM chunks_trigram LIMIT 1 as an empty-check for ensure_trigram
approaches_tried.reason: count(*) on an external-content FTS5 table reads from the content table's rowid range regardless of whether 'rebuild' has run, so it never reports 0 even for a truly unpopulated fresh table -- replaced with a real MATCH-based probe against a sampled content row

approaches_tried.approach: conn.close() without conn.commit() after ensure_trigram's rebuild INSERT
approaches_tried.reason: the INSERT lives in Python sqlite3's implicit per-connection transaction and is silently rolled back on close() since do_search() was read-only before this task -- added explicit conn.commit() after the rebuild insert

deviations.description: ensure_trigram() empty-check via SELECT count(*) FROM chunks_trigram LIMIT 1
deviations.reason: count(*) on an external-content FTS5 table does not reflect index population state; replaced with a MATCH-based probe against a real content sample

deviations.reason: Missing conn.commit() silently rolled back the rebuild INSERT on connection close; added explicit commit
